pre_mortem: It's Monday and this lost. Marks missed because the backfield is a true split, Chubb took the closer carries, Ingram sat, and Marks posted another sub-8-carry, 15-yard afternoon while Houston still won on the ground. That counter-case is real and is why Marks is a lean, not a strong, but it is not stronger than a 23-yard gap between his three-game rush average and 27.5 plus a 5.16 YPC defense, so the lean stays. Pollard cleared 56.5 because the game stayed inside one score, Houston's run defense gave up one of its occasional 10-plus runs, and a 56-yard recent game repeated on a few more carries with Spears not vulturing the efficient ones. The cushion is one yard over his last game, so the under is not thick, but four straight unders plus a 4.01 YPC defense still beat that counter-case. Weather, a late Mills or Marks scratch, or a Simmons/Ingram game-time decision would have been the step that caught a miss, and none of those are locked in the pack.
